selection: After C15/C16, all four C17 and four C18 lists, then the first two C19 lists in the pinned Moxfield index: Merciless Rage and Primal Genesis. Existing alternate editions are not imported twice.
moxfieldAccess: The pinned index supplies queue links. These are verified Wizards / MTGJSON lists, not direct Moxfield exports.
normalization: Budoka Gardener uses its front-face name for the flip card; the complete Scryfall faces are preserved in oracle.json.
